document: AMEC ProposalOps UI product-surface backend census

classification_policy.USER_SURFACE_REQUIRED: Human workflow command or evidence mutation; server authorization remains authoritative.
classification_policy.UI_SUPPORT_API: Read model or register consumed by a human workspace.
classification_policy.SYSTEM_ONLY: Framework, health, historical, qualification, or non-business runtime surface.
classification_policy.INTERNAL_ONLY: Test, fixture, development, or diagnostic support surface.
classification_policy.DEFERRED_AI: AI/intelligence endpoint; excluded from this branch's UI closure.
classification_policy.LATER_PRODUCTION_GATE: Readiness or production gate requiring a later release decision.

notes: The rows are emitted by the executable census script rather than inferred from filenames.
FastAPI included-router candidates are expanded before methods are counted.
The static summary is evidence metadata; rerun the generator after a backend route change.
